bays.road: Low tariff area (Notting Hill and Ladbroke Grove)
bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone — resident permit bays and paid pay-by-phone bays
bays.times: Controlled hours vary by street in this borough — the bay sign is definitive. Pay-by-phone controls commonly run Monday to Saturday from 8.30am, ending at 1.30pm in some areas and 6.30pm in others, with parts of Chelsea controlled into the evening and on Sunday afternoons. Council-published exceptions: Notting Hill Gate bays 10am–4pm Mon–Fri and 10am–1.30pm Sat; Holland Park Avenue bays 10am–6.30pm Mon–Fri and 8.30am–1.30pm Sat. Pay-by-phone bays are free on bank holidays
bays.tariff: Pay-by-phone tariff per hour (RBKC Low tariff area — Notting Hill, Ladbroke Grove, Portobello and Westbourne Park, between the Westway and Holland Park Avenue): electric/zero-emission £3.10; petrol and petrol hybrid £4.10; diesel and diesel hybrid £4.70
bays.pay: PayByPhone (app, online, phone 020 7023 9078, text 65565, or cash at a PayPoint store)

bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone — parking only in marked bays during the controlled hours: pay-and-display / RingGo bays for visitors and permit bays for permit holders. The point shown is the zone label point from the council's own parking zone map; the zone covers the surrounding streets — check the zone entry signs and bay signs. Zones B and C were consolidated into a single Zone B/C (with the former BB and CC zones) from 16 June 2025; the council's zone table still lists B and C separately with these hours.
bays.tariff: Emissions-based pay-and-display charges (per hour, by CO2 band): Band 1 (0 g/km) £2.80; Band 2 (1-75 g/km) £2.80; Band 3 (76-120 g/km) £4.00; Band 4 (120-150 g/km) £4.50; Band 5 (151-186 g/km) £5.50; Band 6 (186-225 g/km) £6.00; Band 7 (225+ g/km) £7.00. Diesel surcharge +£1.00 per hour in any band. With a resident's visitor parking permit, charges are lower and start at £1.80 per hour. The council's map page states on-street pay and display charges do not apply on public holidays, and parking in each zone is free of charge outside the controlled times.
bays.pay: RingGo (app, web or phone — the council's e-parking service), on-street ticket machines (credit/debit card including contactless; cash in town centres), or a resident's visitor parking permit
bays.permits: Resident permit holders; visitor permits from £1.80 per hour
